description: Short-term Photovoltaic Power Forecasting based on Long Short Term Memory Neural Network and Attention Mechanism is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Ke Yan. Photovoltaic (PV) power generation forecasting is an important topic in field of power system, energy conversion and smart grid construction. The PV power generation has the properties of randomness and volatility is due to the variability of solar irradiance, temperature and other meteorological factors. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2018. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
